failure_modes: Synthetic AR(1) returns omit market microstructure, liquidity, impact, and regime changes.
A single seed cannot establish statistical robustness.
Known injected structure is an infrastructure check, not evidence of market predictability.
The simplified cost model is not calibrated to any venue or instrument.
hypothesis: A one-period lagged reversal rule will recover deliberately injected negative autocorrelation out of sample after fixed turnover costs, and its mean net return will exceed a paired IID control.

bias_controls: The hypothesis and thresholds are fixed in this specification before execution.
Exactly one declared trial is permitted; there is no parameter search.
The signal at t uses only the return at t-1.
The out-of-sample segment is contiguous and never used for fitting or selection.
A paired IID control uses the identical innovation sequence.
Transaction costs are charged on every unit of turnover.

next_experiment: Add independent property-based invariants and a preregistered multi-seed sensitivity analysis without selecting the best seed.

result.interpretation: The deterministic runner recovered the deliberately injected structure out of sample. This validates only the experiment plumbing, not a market edge.
